integrity: All claims follow from explicit necessary-and-sufficient graph criteria and elementary generating-function counts. Finite tests are independent corroboration, not mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to simple cycle coronas with one pendant leaf at each cycle vertex and n>=3.
The exact result is for homogeneous degree-proportional threshold 0<rho<=1 and permanent synchronous irreversible activation.
Exhaustive software tests cover n=3..9 and corroborate, but do not establish, universal statements.
Historical priority is provisional, including a 2026 source whose full 39-page manuscript was not obtainable for comprehensive inspection.
title: Threshold phases and exact contagious-set polynomials of sunlet graphs
